notes: Care Compare files are the Aug 2026 release. CMS-certified count (267) differs from OIG licensed count (288 in CY2025). Funded-slot increases in Aug 2026 (MPW +65, SCL +90, HCB +115) match HB 500 SFY2027 appropriations. July 17, 2026 average wait days include both allocated and still-waiting people. The Sept 2, 2025 values in reviewData.js were re-verified and kept as waiver-sept2025-baseline; the newest are Aug 17, 2026 (19,076 unduplicated). The rate-vs-cost estimate is positive (average Medicaid rate above all-payer average cost) but periods differ; treat as indicative. PACE count is a floor because of CMS small-cell suppression. NF Medicaid spending estimate should be replaced by the CMS-64 figure from the finance agent. Facility names appear only in source files, not in this JSON.
